name: esp-pin-planner
description: Visual ESP32 pin planning without changing application source code.

chatParticipants.name: espPinPlanner
chatParticipants.description: Plan ESP32-S3 / C6 / P4 pins from a description; the optimizer assigns the pins and the validator checks them.

commands.name: generate
commands.description: Describe the peripherals to configure; get a validated .pinconfig.json.

commands.name: fix
commands.description: Repair the current .pinconfig.json using the Problems reported for it.

espPinPlanner.defaultTarget.description: Target chip selected by default when creating a new .pinconfig.json via the 'Create New Pin Config' command, or when validate/open is run on an empty workspace.

espPinPlanner.schemaStrictInstance.description: If true, the JSON schema and runtime validator restrict peripheral owner/instance names to the chip-specific set (e.g. no 'uart5' on ESP32-P4). Turn off to allow experimental/free-form instance names with reduced diagnostics.

espPinPlanner.rmtChannelBank.description: RMT channel bank preference used when ESP-IDF boards have per-bank TX-only vs RX-only restrictions on S3/C6. 'auto' warns on ambiguous assignments; 'tx'/'rx' treat all channels as the chosen bank and suppress opposite-direction conflicts.

espPinPlanner.board.preset.description: Board profile selection: 'auto' picks the only shipped board matching the target chip, or the unique board flagged as the chip's reference board (board JSON "default": true); 'none' disables board features (no reserved-pin warnings and default signal-map shortcuts); 'byId' uses vendor+id below.

espPinPlanner.board.vendor.description: Vendor folder name under boards/<vendor>/ when board.preset='byId'.

espPinPlanner.board.id.description: Board id (without .json suffix) under boards/<vendor>/ when board.preset='byId'.

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:extension && npm run build:webview
